title: 2008 AMC 10B Problem 4
statement: A semipro baseball league has teams with \(21\) players each. League rules state that a player must be paid at least \(\$15{,}000,\) and that the total of all players’ salaries for each team cannot exceed \(\$700{,}000.\) What is the maximum possible salary, in dollars, for a single player?

solutions.text:
One player’s salary is largest when the other \(20\) players each earn the minimum \(\$15{,}000.\)

That leaves \(\$700{,}000-20\cdot\$15{,}000\) \(=\$700{,}000-\$300{,}000\) \(=\$400{,}000\) for the single player.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: To maximize one salary, pay everyone else as little as allowed
